projects.name: GG Orchestrator
projects.tagline: A director's console for a team of AI coding agents.
projects.description: GGO plans, dispatches and tracks work across many coding agents at once. Tasks get their own branch, with optional QA and review passes before they land, and the whole office is visible from one board. Over 3,600 commits of daily-driven tooling.

media.alt: A tour of GG Orchestrator on sample tasks: the board, a task with its chat and diff, the Git console, the calendar, patch notes, then settings switching to the Nocturne theme

features: Runs Claude, Codex and other coding agents side by side on one board
Every task gets its own Git branch and worktree, then integrates linearly
Optional planner, QA and reviewer passes before work lands
An office chat where agents coordinate files and hand off work
Shared memory recall so new agents start with past lessons

projects.name: Garden Gnome Swarm
projects.tagline: One private compute fleet out of every machine I own.
projects.description: GGS joins desktops, a Steam Deck, a Raspberry Pi and cloud VMs into one swarm over a private mesh. Each device advertises a CPU and memory budget that always yields to its owner, and every machine's containers can be started, stopped and inspected from one dashboard.

media.alt: A tour of the Garden Gnome Swarm dashboard: device budgets, adding a device with a join code, then planting a container workload

features: Desktops, a Steam Deck, a Raspberry Pi and cloud VMs in one swarm
Private mesh networking, no ports opened to the internet
Per-device CPU and memory budgets that yield to whoever is using the machine
Start, stop and inspect each machine's containers from one dashboard
Built into the GG Orchestrator console

projects.name: Gnomerang
projects.tagline: AI workflow automation for small businesses.
projects.description: A Swiss–Danish studio that turns repetitive office work into reliable automated workflows. Clients get agents wired into the tools they already use, with humans kept in the loop where it matters.

media.alt: Scrolling gnomerang.com through its services and pricing, the Danish site, then the operations console demo

features: Workflow automation, from sorting enquiries to preparing invoices
Specialist AI teams with defined roles working towards a set goal
Connects Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and other everyday tools
People approve, AI does the work
Fixed packages with prices agreed up front

projects.name: Sprogbroen
projects.tagline: Danish for teenagers who just arrived.
projects.description: A learning platform for 14–18-year-old newcomers learning Danish as a second language. Lessons, exercises and audio are written for teenagers in Danish reception classes, not adapted from material for adults.

media.alt: A student's tour of Sprogbroen: home, assignments, a picture exercise, the games, a round of hangman, the grammar pages and the learning path

features: Exercises grouped by word class, with explanations in Danish or English
Eight language games, solo or against classmates
Bro, an AI helper that gives hints instead of answers
A personal learning path and progress tracking
Teacher tools for classes, assignments, stats and messages

projects.name: D2R Overlay & Bot
projects.tagline: Reads the game's memory, then plays it.
projects.description: An overlay for Diablo II: Resurrected that reads live game state straight from memory: map, quests, inventory, gear and objectives. On top of it sits a supervised bot that levels a Sorceress through the acts on its own. Over 7,000 commits, built together with a friend.

media.alt: The bot levelling a Sorceress across acts and difficulties while the overlay shows the objective, quests, map, build and inventory

features: Reads live game state from memory: map, quests, inventory and gear
Overlay with the current objective, session stats and an action log
Supervised bot that levels a Sorceress act by act on its own
Picks up useful finds and stashes them for later
Tracks the mercenary's gear and the character's build

projects.name: WoW Forever Bot
projects.tagline: A complete bot for WoW Forever, and other versions too.
projects.description: An autonomous World of Warcraft bot built for WoW Forever that also runs on other versions of the game. It quests, fights, loots, travels and recovers on its own, and several characters can run side by side. More than 10,000 commits.

media.alt: One bot questing in Tirisfal Glades with its route overlay, then twelve bot-controlled clients questing, fighting and selling side by side

features: Levels new characters from 1 to max without input
Supports WoW Forever plus Classic Era, BC Anniversary and MoP Classic
Questing, class combat rotations, looting and pathing across zones
Relogs by itself after disconnects and recovers from deaths
Runs several characters in parallel, each in its own lane

projects.name: Monster Hunter Now Bot
projects.tagline: Auto-fight for a mobile hunting game.
projects.description: A patched Android build of Monster Hunter Now with an in-game control panel. It aims, dodges and fires on its own, and handles crafting between hunts.

media.alt: The in-game control panel and map, a full hunt through to the results screen, then a Khezu fight

features: Auto All: walks to a monster, starts a solo hunt, fights and repeats
Auto Fight with weapon-specific aiming and dodging
Auto Quest and a monster and star filter for grinding
Forges, upgrades and picks the best armor between hunts
Smart healing, simulated GPS and an in-game control panel

projects.name: Defend Your Castle
projects.tagline: A browser castle defence with a real leaderboard.
projects.description: A Unity game that runs in the browser. Waves get harder, 223 permanent upgrades keep you coming back, and the online leaderboard is server-authoritative so scores can't be faked.

media.alt: The title screen, a battle where enemies are picked up and thrown, upgrade picks between waves, then wave two

features: Grab enemies and throw them into the ground
29 enemy types across six factions, with a boss every fifth wave
72 draft cards and 223 permanent upgrades across five eras
Server-authoritative online leaderboard
Three battle speeds and two evolving player spells
